question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. (i).
solution:
The correct answer is '**feeling**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes a sense of familiarity or déjà-vu experienced by many Americans on the afternoon of 30 March 1981.
 
• The appropriate noun should indicate an emotion or sensation experienced by the people.
 
• "**Feeling**" fits well as it accurately describes the sensation of déjà-vu referred to in the passage.
 
• Other options ("**Blinking**", "**Recalling**", "**Dealing**") do not appropriately capture the context of déjà-vu, a sensation of familiarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *On the afternoon of 30 March 1981, many Americans experienced a 1. feeling__ of déjà-vu. Déjà-vu is a name given to the feeling that a person has seen or experienced an event before. Many Americans could not help having that feeling on this day. The 2. ________ hit TVs and radios immediately. President Ronald Reagan had been shot. He was leaving a hotel in Washington DC, turned to wave at some of the people gathered to see him, and fell towards the ground. Before he could hit the ground, his Secret Service Agents 3. **________ **him into the car and rushed to the nearest hospital. This same story had been heard before. On 22 November 1963 President John F Kennedy was riding in a motorcade through Dallas, Texas. He smiled and waved to the crowd that had gathered to see him. 4. **________ **rang out from a nearby building. The President collapsed into the backseat of the car and was immediately taken to the nearest hospital. He was 5. **________ **dead at the hospital. Now, just seventeen years later, the news sounded eerily the same.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Blinking** (पलक झपकना): "Blinking" refers to the action of shutting and opening the eyes, which does not fit the context of describing an emotional experience.
 
• **Recalling** (स्मरण करना): "Recalling" means remembering something, which suggests an active process of memory retrieval, not a passive sense of familiarity.
 
• **Dealing** (निपटना): "Dealing" means handling or addressing a situation, which does not match the idea of experiencing a feeling of familiarity.
